page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 32 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 mapping of threads per core, providing 32 vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The reliance on HDD storage instead of SSDs represents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing raw storage volume and cost-per-gigabyte efficiency over random read/write IOPS. Consequently, this instance is structured for workloads that require massive sequential data access and high storage density, such as large-scale data warehousing, log processing, MapReduce jobs, and distributed file systems.
